prompt:
Create one landscape 3:2 MOOD BOARD sheet for a vanilla Minecraft 1.21.1 public build catalog. Crisp voxel blocks, plain warm light background, beautifully organized architectural concept sheet, no characters, animals, villagers, wool, scenery or ground courses. Title: "GOLDEN GATE BRIDGE · 1937" and subtitle "SOUTH TOWER + SUSPENSION KIT · 0.5 BLOCK / METRE". This must unmistakably depict San Francisco's International Orange Golden Gate Bridge.

Layout: upper half has THREE small complete assembly thumbnail takes, each showing the south tower on its sea pier and both sweeping suspension approaches with road and orange truss, varying isometric viewpoint and restrained stepped steel detailing, NEVER changing the mandatory dimensions. Show thumbnail labels "01 / PORTAL", "02 / CABLE SWEEP", "03 / DECK RHYTHM". Four detailed close-up callouts in middle: "STEPPED ART DECO PORTAL", "CABLE SADDLE + SUSPENDERS", "WARREN TRUSS + LAMP", "PIER + ELLIPTICAL FENDER". Bottom has generous block swatch strip grouped by roles, exact legible block ids beneath each cube: STEEL BODY minecraft:red_terracotta and minecraft:orange_terracotta; TRIM minecraft:red_concrete and minecraft:orange_concrete; ROAD minecraft:gray_concrete; LANE LINES minecraft:white_concrete and minecraft:yellow_concrete; PIER minecraft:light_gray_concrete and minecraft:smooth_stone; LIGHTS minecraft:lantern; WARNING minecraft:red_stained_glass and minecraft:glowstone. This bridge has no roof or windows; do not invent those. Use actual vanilla blocks only, orange terracotta/concrete slender voxel suspender lines. Railings orange block/pane geometry, no fabricated orange fence block ids. No iron_chain, pale oak or post-1.21.1 blocks.

Exact kit geometry, preserve in all illustrations: bridge runs north-south along z, north low z, east high x. All y refer to sea level y0; nothing important at y0, empty space air, no landscape base. Scale tower 113 blocks above sea. Four modules with global plot x ranges 0..46,47..61,62..76,77..91; all module coordinates below LOCAL. Deck always 15 wide, two main cable lines 14 apart. Modules 1/2/3 cable lines x0 and14; tower module x16 and30. Shared cross-section: road y38 x3..11, sidewalks x1..2 and12..13 y38; tower road x19..27. White and yellow lane stripes, orange edge girders and railing y39 x0/14. Warren diagonal stiffening truss both outer faces y34..37, floor beams and lateral bracing. One paired orange Art Deco lamp with lantern every16 z at z8, about4 tall, sufficient walkway/deck lighting.

West leg x14..18 east leg x28..32, both z8..15 from y5..112, stepped taper each25 blocks, fluted riveted steel cells/recessed vertical panels every face. FOUR horizontal portal struts near y55,72,90,106..112 with stepped recessed rectangular frames. Big X/K crossbrace below deck y6..33. Deck through portal whole z0..23; sidewalks divert outward around legs on cantilevers x12..13 and33..34. Stepped tower caps y114..116, red glass/glowstone warning lights. Saddle over x16/30, leave cable cells y112..113 open. Concrete pier x11..35 z5..18 y1..5. Elliptical fender ring 2 thick y1..3, touches x0/46 and z0/23, open air representing sea between ring and pier. Show waterline as a delicate annotation only.

Module1 repeatable DECK: 15x16 x0..14 z0..15, y34..44 ONLY. Seamless z ends, exact shared cross section, lamp pair z8; suspender anchors both edges z0,4,8,12 y38..39.
Module2 MAIN CABLES:15x249 x0..14 z0..248 y<=116; ONLY cables/suspenders in the module, illustrated over assembled deck in thumbnails. Twin cable lines x0/14 follow y=41.9+0.00069*(z+72)^2, z0 y45.5,40 50.6,80 57.8,120 67.3,160 79,200 93,240 109.4,248 112.8 at tower saddle. Continuous unbroken voxel curves, vertical fills where needed, cable bands; vertical suspenders every4 z down to y40.
Module3 SIDE CABLES:15x232 z0..231 y<=116, ONLY cables/suspenders. u=z+0.5, y=112.8-0.6475u+0.001165u² for z0..171, then LEVEL y36 z172..231 to anchorage outside kit. Twin lines x0/14; z0 y112.5,40 88.8,80 68.8,120 52.7,160 40.4,171 36. Suspenders every4 z from12..171 ONLY to railing heights z12..43 y40,44..75 y39,76..107 y38,108..139 y37,140..171 y36. No suspenders on level tail. Fort Point arch and anchorage are other kits: do not draw as included modules.

Prioritize iconic tall twin-leg Art Deco tower, FOUR stepped portal struts, long paired cable catenaries, dense vertical hangers, orange underdeck diagonal truss, grey roadway, sea pier and oval fender. Add concise dimension tags "15 WIDE / CABLES 14 APART", "ROAD y38 / TRUSS y34–37", "TOWER ≤ y116", and small module silhouettes labeled "00 TOWER 47×24", "01 DECK 15×16", "02 MAIN 15×249", "03 SIDE 15×232". Elegant readable lettering, plenty of spacing, all structures crisp Minecraft voxel style. This is a mood board of the specified kit, not a fabricated exact construction blueprint.
reads: International Orange steel represented by red and orange terracotta and concrete.
Tall twin-leg Art Deco tower with fluted faces and stepped rectangular portal struts.
Paired main cables sweeping in long curves from the tower saddles.
Closely spaced vertical suspender lines connecting cables to the deck.
Orange Warren truss with repeating diagonal braces beneath the roadway.
Gray roadway with white and yellow markings, sidewalks, and orange railings.
Repeated lantern street lamps along the deck.
Stepped tower caps with red warning lights.
Concrete tower pier surrounded by an elliptical concrete fender.
